premise: A new magnolia bud on the meadow won't open: Pachycephalosaurus bounces round it, Triceratops gives it a friendly nudge, and only shy Stegosaurus, who knows what shy feels like, lies down quietly beside it and waits — and in the warm sun it opens, to him first.
inspiration: The three-tries pattern of folk tales — the bouncy try, the pushy try and the quiet one — with the quiet one winning a friend, not a prize.
lesson: A quiet friend can be the kindest one.

en-US.title: Two Shy Friends
en-US.text: {flower:enter} {flower:live close hold} [gently] Overnight, a new magnolia flower had grown on the meadow. But she stayed folded up, tight as a bud. {pachycephalosaurus:enter} {pachycephalosaurus:go to flower} {sfx:boing} Pachycephalosaurus came bouncing over. {pachycephalosaurus:live bounce} [excited] "Hello! Open up! Come and play!" Nothing. Not one petal. {triceratops:enter} {triceratops:go to flower} Triceratops gave the bud a {triceratops:live nudge} gentle nudge. [warmly] "Come on, little one." Nothing at all. {triceratops:face sad} {pachycephalosaurus:face sad} So they gave up, and {pachycephalosaurus:go away} off they went {triceratops:go away} to play somewhere else. {stegosaurus:enter} Stegosaurus had watched it all. He was shy too, so he knew. {stegosaurus:go to flower} He tiptoed over, lay down beside the bud, and didn't say a single word. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} The sun came out, warm and soft. One petal moved. {sfx:petals} Then another. {flower:live close resume} And slowly, Flower opened, cream and pink. {flower:face happy} [softly] "Hello," she whispered, to Stegosaurus first of all. {stegosaurus:live blush} Stegosaurus went all shy, and smiled. {stegosaurus:face happy} When the others came back, {pachycephalosaurus:go back} {triceratops:go back} [happily] they found two shy friends, side by side, in the sun. {canvas:sunshine stop}

es-ES.title: Dos amigos tímidos
es-ES.text: {flower:enter} {flower:live close hold} [gently] Durante la noche, en el prado había crecido una magnolia nueva. Pero estaba cerrada, apretadita como un capullo. {pachycephalosaurus:enter} {pachycephalosaurus:go to flower} {sfx:boing} Paquicefalosaurio llegó dando botes. {pachycephalosaurus:live bounce} [excited] —¡Hola! ¡Ábrete! ¡Ven a jugar! Nada. Ni un pétalo. {triceratops:enter} {triceratops:go to flower} Triceratops le dio al capullo un {triceratops:live nudge} empujoncito suave. [warmly] —Venga, pequeña. Nada de nada. {triceratops:face sad} {pachycephalosaurus:face sad} Así que se cansaron, y {pachycephalosaurus:go away} se fueron {triceratops:go away} a jugar a otra parte. {stegosaurus:enter} Estegosaurio lo había visto todo. Él también era tímido, así que lo entendía. {stegosaurus:go to flower} Se acercó de puntillas, se tumbó junto al capullo y no dijo ni una palabra. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Salió el sol, tibio y suave. Un pétalo se movió. {sfx:petals} Luego otro. {flower:live close resume} Y poco a poco, Flor se abrió, blanca y rosa. {flower:face happy} [softly] —Hola —susurró, a Estegosaurio el primero de todos. {stegosaurus:live blush} Estegosaurio se puso muy tímido, y sonrió. {stegosaurus:face happy} Cuando los otros volvieron, {pachycephalosaurus:go back} {triceratops:go back} [happily] encontraron a dos amigos tímidos, uno junto al otro, al sol. {canvas:sunshine stop}
